title: Sweep Request 1.1
description: Sent by the app with one or more photos of one Place to the household's factory (ADR-0004), which answers with a Sweep Result 1.1. The manual Project round-trip keeps using 1.0.

path.description: Full Home Tree path of the target Place, e.g. 'Attic -> eaves closet -> blue bin'.

hint.description: Optional free-text note from the person about what to focus on in the photo.

knownItems.description: Names of the Items already kept at this Place, so the answer reuses the household's words rather than inventing near-duplicates.

knownContainers.description: Names of the Containers already inside this Place, so a Container seen in the photo is matched rather than proposed twice.
